content.introduction: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) is a government agency within the Department of Labor, founded in 1885. It is the principal fact-finding agency for the U.S. government in the broad field of labor economics and statistics. The BLS collects, processes, analyzes, and disseminates essential statistical data to the American public, the U.S. Congress, other federal agencies, state and local governments, businesses, and labor representatives. The BLS headquarters are located in Washington, DC, and it has a presence on social media platforms such as Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, and YouTube. The official website is www.bls.gov.
